title: About — Oribos
description: Oribos is an umbrella brand for an open-source agent framework of composable pieces. The Framework is live; the Platform is planned.

sections.heading: What Oribos is
sections.body:
Oribos is the umbrella brand for an open-source agent framework and a planned platform. The [Framework](/ai-agent-framework/) is the live product: a library of composable pieces — agents, workflows, memory, a harness, and capability packages — that you add to your own application.

It is not a platform you operate, a hosted service you buy, or a blank file you have to fill in. You start with the core and add capability packages one at a time.

sections.heading: Product family
sections.body:
The product family has two layers. The Framework is live and is what this site documents. The Platform is planned: a hosted path for running and operating agents. Studio and Agent Builder are faces of the Platform, not separate products.

There are no dates or commitments attached to the Platform.

sections.heading: Who maintains it
sections.body: Oribos is maintained by a small maintainer-led team. There is no larger company organization behind this site. The same team delivers Forward-Deployed Engineering engagements; everything else lands in the repository's issues.

sections.heading: Where to get help
sections.body:
Start with the [documentation](/docs/), or open an issue in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/0xnicholas/oribos-framework/issues). For production work, FDE and support are available through [FDE + Support](/fde-support/).

Support is best effort through GitHub Issues, with no SLA.

sections.heading: Build with Oribos.
sections.body: Read the documentation or explore the source on GitHub.
